description: Land Acquisition - Udumbugala, Medawachchiya D/S/D, Anuradhapura Disrtrict
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose. It provides detailed descriptions of land lots, their extents, and boundaries. While it is issued by a named Minister, the core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition, which falls squarely under the "Land Gazettes" (Type 4) category for land and property-related matters. The mention of the minister is incidental to the legal authority making the declaration, not the primary focus of the content.
